description: A user's payment profile. Records the ordered list of preferred brokers and per-channel accepts flags. The brokers list is account-idempotent: any compliant PoS or broker can resolve who handles payments for a given DID.

items.description: did:web of a broker that may settle payments on behalf of this user.

brokers.description: Ordered list of preferred brokers. First broker that accepts the payment processes it. Defaults to the PoS home authority when omitted.

acceptsItems.description: Whether the user accepts one-time items (default: true).

acceptsSubscriptions.description: Whether the user accepts subscriptions (default: true).

view.description: Profile view for API responses. `acceptingPayments` is server-derived from the broker list and is not stored on the record.

acceptingPayments.description: True when at least one broker on the profile is configured to accept payments. For v2, the mere presence of a broker on the list is taken as readiness.
